cards.back: Something we want to find out.
cards.say: question. Something we want to find out.

cards.back: To say what you think will happen.
cards.say: predict. To say what you think will happen.

cards.back: To decide what to do and what tools to use.
cards.say: plan. To decide what to do and what tools to use.

cards.back: A test where only one thing changes.
cards.say: fair test. A test where only one thing changes.

cards.back: To find out the size or amount of something.
cards.say: measure. To find out the size or amount of something.

cards.back: To write or draw what you find.
cards.say: record. To write or draw what you find.

cards.back: What you find out at the end.
cards.say: results. What you find out at the end.

cards.back: To say how things are the same or different.
cards.say: compare. To say how things are the same or different.

cards.back: To look closely and notice things.
cards.say: observe. To look closely and notice things.

cards.back: What the results tell you.
cards.say: conclusion. What the results tell you.

cards.back: A grid used to record results.
cards.say: table. A grid used to record results.

cards.back: A chart that shows results with bars.
cards.say: bar chart. A chart that shows results with bars.

cards.back: The tools and things you use in a test.
cards.say: equipment. The tools and things you use in a test.

cards.back: To do a test again to check the results.
cards.say: repeat. To do a test again to check the results.

cards.back: Something that happens again and again in results.
cards.say: pattern. Something that happens again and again in results.

cards.back: What we measure with, such as centimetres or seconds.
cards.say: unit. What we measure with, such as centimetres or seconds.

cards.back: A ruler.
cards.say: Which tool measures length? A ruler.

cards.back: A stopwatch.
cards.say: Which tool measures time? A stopwatch.

cards.front: Why do we plan a test first?
cards.back: So we know what to do and what to keep the same.
cards.say: Why do we plan a test first? So we know what to do and what to keep the same.

cards.front: Why do we make a prediction?
cards.back: So we can see whether we were right.
cards.say: Why do we make a prediction? So we can see whether we were right.

cards.front: Why do we look for patterns?
cards.back: Patterns help us explain what happens.
cards.say: Why do we look for patterns? Patterns help us explain what happens.

cards.back: So nobody gets hurt.
cards.say: Why do we work safely? So nobody gets hurt.
